## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` and `make lint` are green locally
- [ ] New behavior comes with a test; bug fixes come with a regression test
- [ ] User-visible changes update `docs/user-docs`; architectural or contract changes update `docs/dev-docs`
- [ ] No frozen contract (see `AGENTS.md`) is extended as a side effect
- [ ] I have signed the Contributor License Agreement (`CONTRIBUTOR_LICENSE_AGREEMENT.md` — the CLA check will prompt on your first PR)
